data.name: Erlinda
data.gender_notes: Erlinda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Erlinda is derived from the old Germanic word 'erilaz' meaning 'helper' and the Old Spanish word 'lind' meaning 'weak'. Together, the name Erlinda means 'Helper of the weak'. The name Erlinda carries the meaning “Helper of the weak” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Erlinda usually hope their child will grow to embody helper of the weak and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who wish to help and support others in need.
data.etymology: Erlinda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper of the weak.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Erlinda total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: ארלינדה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ארלינדה הוא שם המשלב את המילה 'אל' המייצגת את אלוהים, עם השם לינדה שפירושו נדיבה או יפה. השם ארלינדה משמעותו 'נדיבת אלוהים' או 'אלוהים הוא נדיב', ומשרת כזיקוק לנוכחות האלוהית בחייה של הנושאת אותו.

in_greek.name: Ερλίνδα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ερλίνδα προέρχεται από τη σύνθεση των λέξεων 'Ερ' που σημαίνει 'αρχ' ή ' Θεός' και 'λίνδα' που σημαίνει ' όμορφη' ή 'αγαθή'. Η Ερλίνδα επομένως σημαίνει 'η χάρις του Θεού' ή 'η ομορφιά του Θεού', αντανακλώντας το δώρο της θείας αγάπης.

in_latin.name: Erlinda
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Erlinda derivatur ex compositione vocum 'Er' quae 'initium' vel 'Deus' significat, et 'Linda' quae 'pulchra' seu 'bona' interpretatur. Erlinda itaque 'donum Dei' seu 'gratia divina' significat, exprimens munus amoris divini.

in_english.name: Erlinda
in_english.long_meaning: The name Erlinda is of Germanic origin, derived from 'Er' meaning 'noble' and 'Linda' meaning 'beautiful' or 'gift'. In Christian context, Erlinda signifies 'God's gift' or 'noble gift from God', reflecting divine benevolence and grace. Historically, the name has been used across various cultures, symbolizing spiritual richness and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Erlinda embodies a strong sense of compassion, care, and nurturing. As a helper of the weak, Erlindas are often seen as caring, empathetic, and selfless individuals who are always there to lend a helping hand to those in need. This can be reflected in various aspects of their culture, from their role in families and communities to their careers and personal relationships.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Erlinda lies in its reminder of the importance of compassion and selflessness in our lives. AsHelpers of the weak, Erlindas are called to use their God-given gifts and talents to make a positive impact on the world around them. This can be seen as a reflection of God's love and compassion for all people, regardless of their circumstances.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Erlinda may be derived from the Old German words "eran" (early) and "lind" (gentle), thus signifying an early-born gentle soul. Spiritually, it suggests a person who arrives in the world with a tender and compassionate disposition, with a deep capacity for nurturing and caring for others.

historical_references.reference: The name Erlinda has been used throughout Christian history by saints, scholars, and faithful believers who exemplified its meaning.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Erlinda remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
